nodes.name: backend/Dockerfile
nodes.summary: Multi-stage Docker build for the backend Node.js application using node:22-alpine. The builder stage installs production dependencies, and the final stage copies node_modules and application code, runs as a non-root user, and starts server.js on port 5000.
nodes.languageNotes: Multi-stage build pattern separates dependency installation from runtime, reducing image size. Non-root user enhances security. Creates storage directories for avatars and mountain-photos at build time.

nodes.name: builder

nodes.name: node
nodes.summary: Runtime stage that copies dependencies from the builder, sets up a non-root nodejs user, copies application code, creates storage directories, and starts the server on port 5000.

nodes.name: Dockerfile
nodes.summary: Multi-stage Docker build producing a minimal nginx-based production image for the frontend application. The builder stage compiles the React/Vite application, and the runtime stage serves static assets with a custom nginx configuration running as non-root.
nodes.languageNotes: Multi-stage build separates the Node.js build environment from the lightweight nginx runtime. Non-root nginx configuration enhances container security. Static assets are served from /usr/share/nginx/html with custom nginx.conf.

nodes.languageNotes: Uses Node.js built-in test runner with async/await, fetch API for HTTP requests, and cookie jar management.

nodes.name: updateCookieJar
nodes.summary: Parses Set-Cookie headers and updates the cookie jar map, handling session expiration via max-age=0.

nodes.name: request
nodes.summary: Helper function that wraps fetch with automatic cookie handling, JSON serialization, and header management.

nodes.name: json
nodes.summary: Simple helper that parses JSON from a response object.

nodes.name: destinationQuality.test.js
nodes.summary: Unit tests for destination guide quality scoring, verifying that guide profiles are complete and that destinations without verified media cannot become ready.

nodes.name: eligibleDestination
nodes.summary: Factory function that creates a test destination object with sensible defaults for guide quality testing.

nodes.name: ingestion.test.js
nodes.summary: Unit tests for the ingestion service verifying HTTPS URL validation and Wikimedia text extraction to plain text.

nodes.name: security.test.js
nodes.summary: Unit tests for security middleware validating environment secret requirements and role-based access control.

nodes.name: requireRole
nodes.summary: Express middleware factory that returns a role-checking middleware function for authorization.

nodes.name: weatherWindow.test.js
nodes.summary: Unit tests for weather window service covering forecast summarization, scoring algorithms, and date range validation.

nodes.name: forecastPayload
nodes.summary: Factory function that creates a test weather forecast payload with hourly data for scoring tests.

nodes.name: vite.config.ts
nodes.summary: Vite development server configuration with React plugin support and proxy rules for backend API routes to localhost:5000.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Vite's defineConfig with proxy configuration for development, supporting WebSocket (ws: true) and HTML navigation bypass.

nodes.name: bypassHtmlNavigation
nodes.summary: Proxy bypass function that returns index.html for HTML navigation requests but lets API calls through to the backend.

nodes.name: mountains
nodes.summary: Stores curated and fetched media assets (photos) for mountains with licensing and attribution metadata.

nodes.name: blogs
nodes.summary: Editorial blog catalog table with enhanced metadata for blog post management.

nodes.name: users
nodes.summary: User accounts table referenced by editorial blog catalog for author tracking.

nodes.name: reviews
nodes.summary: Reviews table deduplication migration with cleanup of duplicate entries.

nodes.name: users
nodes.summary: Users table referenced by review deduplication migration.

nodes.name: setupDefaultAvatar
nodes.summary: Creates the default user avatar image from SVG, converts to PNG using sharp, and ensures the avatars directory exists.

nodes.name: index.jsx
